Today.title: Your next step
Today.description: Your current plan comes from your target and the evidence the product can support now.
Today.targetDescription: Keep the target used for planning up to date.
Today.targetSetupDescription: Choose your IELTS variant and at least one overall or skill Band target.
Today.unresolvedDescription: These target conditions are unresolved. They are not learner weaknesses.
Today.noRecommendation: There is no current Planner recommendation. Product limits or unresolved target conditions are shown separately when present.
Today.coverageDescription: This is a product limitation, not a learner weakness.
Today.trainingBoundary: This is training. It does not count as Reading Band evidence.
Today.assessmentBoundary: This is a sampled assessment activity. Submission may be considered by Assessment, but the activity alone does not establish a Reading Band or readiness.
Today.trainingCompleted: Training submitted. This activity does not count as Reading Band evidence.
Today.assessmentCompleted: Assessment submitted. This sampled activity does not by itself establish a Reading Band or readiness.
Today.directDescription: Practice directly. This is separate from the Planner recommendation and remains non-evidence training.
Today.unavailable: This recommendation is no longer available. Today has been refreshed.

why.prerequisiteGap: A required prerequisite needs attention before broader work.
why.abilityGap: Current evidence supports focused work on this ability.
why.insufficientEvidence: We need more independent evidence for this part of Reading.
why.conflictingEvidence: Recent evidence conflicts, so a focused check is useful next.
why.staleEvidence: The available evidence is too old for the current decision.
why.scaffoldDependence: Independent performance needs another check after supported work.
why.transferGap: The next step checks whether the skill transfers to a different context.
why.fluencyGap: The next step focuses on making accurate performance more fluent.
why.reviewDue: This material is due for review.
why.examConditionGap: Practice under closer exam conditions is the next useful step.
why.deliveryModePreparation: The next step prepares for the delivery conditions in your target.
why.productCoverageBlocked: The product cannot currently support part of the required route.

errors.targetVariant: Choose Academic or General Training before saving the target.
errors.targetBand: Enter at least one overall or skill Band constraint before saving the target.

Today.signInRequired: Sign in with Clerk to continue.
